limit.description: The maximum number of products to return in the response. Use this to control page size for pagination.

skip.description: The number of products to skip in the query result. Use this to implement pagination, e.g., to get the next page of results.

category.description: The product category name or identifier to query. Example values: 'electronics', 'clothing', 'home_goods'

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return in the response. Must be a positive integer. Example: 20

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination. Use for retrieving subsequent pages of results. Example: 0 for the first page, 20 for the next 20 items
